member.name: T:Rgd.GraphQL.Server.Configuration.PropertiesConfigurationProvider
member.summary: Exposes a Java style application.properties file as an source.
member.remarks:
Keys are mapped onto the .NET configuration model so that they bind to the options classes:
flightsql.tls.trust-server-certificate becomes flightsql:tls:trustservercertificate: dots are section separators and dashes are dropped, the binder being case-insensitive.
logging.level.<category> becomes Logging:LogLevel:<category>, the category being kept verbatim since it is itself dotted (logging.level.Microsoft.AspNetCore=Warning).

member.name: T:Rgd.GraphQL.Server.Data.FlightSql.FlightSqlAuthInterceptor
member.summary: Authenticates the Flight SQL calls with the configured credentials.
member.remarks:
Every call carries Basic credentials until the server hands a bearer token back in the authorization response header, as the Arrow GeneratedBearerTokenAuthenticator of the rgd-http-proxy does. The token is then used instead, sparing the server a credential validation per call, until drops it.
This is a plain gRPC interceptor rather than an Arrow IFlightClientMiddleware: the Arrow adapter of the middlewares replaces the of a failed call by an , losing its status code.

member.name: M:Rgd.GraphQL.Server.Model.ModelLoader.GraphQLName
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z_a-z].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically any number of times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Rgd.GraphQL.Server.Model.ModelLoader.SqlIdentifier

○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
